# Playwright with Cucumber Project Setup

This is a Playwright project integrated with Cucumber for BDD (Behavior Driven Development) testing.

## Progress Checklist

- [x] Verify that the copilot-instructions.md file in the .github directory is created.
- [x] Clarify Project Requirements - Playwright + Cucumber BDD testing framework
- [x] Scaffold the Project
- [x] Customize the Project
- [x] Install Required Extensions
- [x] Compile the Project
- [x] Create and Run Task
- [ ] Launch the Project
- [x] Ensure Documentation is Complete

## Project Structure

- `features/` - Gherkin feature files
- `step-definitions/` - Step implementation files
- `src/` - Source code and utilities
- `playwright.config.ts` - Playwright configuration
- `package.json` - Project dependencies and scripts
